_meta.purpose: Which body system a CLASS of prescription acts on, keyed by the class keys of med_classes.json and answering with the domain keys of radar_domains.json. Read by engine/system_panels.py for layer 4 of a system's card (the person's current prescriptions acting on this system) and by engine/decision.py to reach a prescription's genes through the system it acts on: class -> system -> the system's genetic half. Small on purpose.
_meta.who_writes_this: The project, and only for rows that are facts BY THE NAME of the class: a thyroid hormone acts on the thyroid, a statin on the lipid panel, a gliflozin on carbohydrate metabolism. Nothing here is a claim about a person; a row is a statement about what the class is called and which laboratory panel carries that name.
_meta.gate: A class with no row here is not silently absent from a system's card: the engine prints the prescription with status «no_map», so that a prescription nobody mapped is visible as an unmapped one rather than looking like one that acts on nothing. A row naming a system key that radar_domains.json does not hold is dropped and counted.
_meta.why: Until this file existed the prescription entry waited for a hand-written gene list per drug, and the system card could not say which of the person's prescriptions bear on it at all. One class-to-system fact closes both: a prescription reaches the genetic half of the system it acts on, and the card lists the prescriptions that act on it. The map is the join, and it is the only new knowledge the join needs.
_meta.why_partial: Every class whose system is a matter of INDICATION rather than of name is left out, because choosing it would be a clinical judgement made by this project: the antihypertensive classes (ace_inhibitor, arb, beta_blocker, ccb, thiazide, loop_diuretic) have no blood-pressure domain on the radar and act on the kidney, the heart and the vessels at once; anticoagulants and antiplatelets (anticoagulant_vka, doac, antiplatelet_p2y12), antibiotics and antifungals (macrolide, azole_antifungal), acid suppressants (ppi, h2_blocker), analgesics and psychotropics (nsaid, opioid_codeine, ssri_snri), immunosuppressants (thiopurine), antiarrhythmics; and the supplements whose target is a use rather than a name (supplement_k2, soluble_fiber, berberine, niacin, iodine, vitamin_b6_source, probiotic, probiotic_yeast, inositol, alpha_lipoic_acid, rhodiola). A clinician may add any of them with a source; the engine will not.
_meta.schema: classes: { <med_classes.json class key>: { systems: [<radar_domains.json domain key>, ...], source: '<why this row is a fact>' } }

vitamin_d.source: the class name; the panel carries the marker of the same name

gh_secretagogue.source: the class name; the growth axis carries the hormone of the same name
